industry: Optical Communications / Specialty Glass and Ceramics
thesis: Corning is the dominant provider of optical fiber and cable for AI data center buildouts, with partnerships at Amazon and NVIDIA driving a multiyear demand inflection. Q2 2026 core sales grew 17% YoY to $4.74B and core EPS rose 30% YoY to $0.78, with operating margin expanding to 20.9%. The July 2026 guidance reset and AI infrastructure rotation have compressed the multiple, creating a more attractive entry point for patient investors who can look through near-term volatility.

drivers: AI data center fiber demand sustains 20%+ Optical Communications growth through 2027
Amazon and NVIDIA partnerships expand into higher-value co-packaged optics and specialty fiber
Display Technologies margins stabilize as OLED glass mix improves
Gorilla Glass and semiconductor glass drive double-digit Specialty Materials growth

base_case.assumptions: Optical Communications grows 15–20% annually as AI buildout continues but moderates; Display Technologies remains flat-to-down on weak consumer demand; Specialty Materials grows high single digits; overall margins expand modestly. Stock re-rates to ~25–30x forward earnings as execution remains solid.

risks: Hyperscaler AI capex digestion extends the guidance miss into 2027
Display Technologies deterioration accelerates on LCD/OLED oversupply
Input cost inflation or tariff pressure crimps gross margins
Interest rates stay higher for longer, compressing the multiple on a capital-intensive business

catalysts.event: Q3 2026 earnings — guidance update and AI fiber order commentary
2027 capital allocation plan and Springboard plan milestones
Potential data center customer win or co-packaged optics announcement

key_risks: AI capex cyclicality and hyperscaler demand digestion
Weak consumer electronics hurting Display Technologies
Capital intensity and sensitivity to interest rates
Customer concentration in large cloud and telecom accounts
